title: ActivationLockStatus.Attributes
description:
Attributes for an organization device’s Activation Lock status.

Apple School Manager API 1.7+

> **Note:** When additional attributes are added by Apple, they appear automatically, without requiring a newer version of the API.

isLocked.description: Whether the device is currently Activation Locked.

lockType.description: The type of Activation Lock on the device, if `isLocked` is `true`. Possible values: `MDM`, `USER`, `NONE`
